arrays.title: Panel arrays
arrays.none: No array declared yet. Add one: its modules are drawn on the roof, and each slot gets its inverter.
arrays.hint: Drag any module in the 3D view: the whole array follows.
arrays.heightHint: Height of the array above the level floor. A flat roof is a thick slab: at 0 the array is buried in it.
arrays.azimuthHint: The direction the modules face: the cone drawn on the array shows it.
arrays.slopeHint: The slope the array sits on: the roof's. 0 on a flat roof, on the ground or on a terrace.
arrays.tiltHint: Each module's angle on its support: the rack that lifts it. 0 = flush with the roof.
arrays.maxOutputHint: Maximum output power of a micro-inverter in this field, from its datasheet (480 W on an IQ8P): above that it clips, and the reading stops there rather than at the module's peak. A mark shows it at the foot of the Energy view gauges, a second one shows each inverter's own record. Leave at 0 when unknown.
arrays.peakHint: Peak power of one module (Wp), as printed on the back of the panel. It is the colour scale: the module's slab in the house, the gauge behind its row in the Energy view. A micro-inverter often clips below it.
arrays.removeHint: Remove this array from the house: its modules leave the scene and its inverters become devices to place again

vehicle.wakeHint: The vehicle sleeps to save its battery; the values shown are the last known. Waking it up is billed by Tesla.
vehicle.capacityHint: The carmaker does not report the battery capacity. It is only used to estimate charging power.
vehicle.refreshHint: Reads the vehicle now (one read billed by Tesla); polling restarts from this read.

render.title: 3D rendering
render.assetsHint: Free photo textures (ambientCG, CC0) instead of the computed materials: plaster, parquet, grass, pavers… The style keeps its colours for the rest.
render.assetsNone: This style is fully computed: it has no photo materials.
render.ambienceHint: Independent from the app's light/dark theme: « Automatic » follows the real sun above the house, from its GPS origin and the clock.
render.projectionHint: « Flat » removes the vanishing point: parallel lines stay parallel, and you still orbit the house freely. « Isometric » also locks the angles — the 45° corner, a fixed pitch — and the view then only turns a quarter at a time; finger and left button pan it instead of rotating it.
render.qualityHint: Lamp glow, corner occlusion and anti-aliasing. « Automatic » picks from the machine, then steps down if frames cost too much.
render.weatherHint: Debug only: forces a weather onto the 3D scene to see it under rain or snow. The widget and the Weather view keep showing the real weather.
render.debugHint: Puts a measurement overlay on the scene: frames per second, CPU cost of a frame, draw calls, passes and shadow rebuilds. « img/s » at 0 when idle is normal — rendering is on demand.

tuning.title: Tune the light
tuning.hint: Tuning bench: presets, exposure, bloom, lamp glow and the selected room's outline, adjusted live in front of the house. The sliders multiply what the style computes — the day/night curve is kept. What you save is written to the house file and applies to every tablet.

presetHints.soft: The same picture without the glare: only real sources bloom, the lamp halo is halved, the outline underlines instead of shouting.
presetHints.cinema: AgX curve: an overexposed lamp keeps its hue instead of turning white. Wider aperture, deeper vignette — a photograph.
presetHints.plain: For the hallway tablet: almost no bloom, no vignette, a crisp opaque outline readable at a glance.
presetHints.model: The model-house spirit: still glowing, but lit walls stop bleeding.

render.houseEditingHint: The Home view then lets you adjust and drag windows and doors on the walls, and lay out parking spots on the ground. The survey is approximate: this is where it gets corrected, and nothing is written until something is actually adjusted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Auto goes dark half an hour before sunset; System follows the device's light/dark setting.
settings.sceneAutoDynamicNewHint: Default behaviour for an animated scene that appears (created at the vendor, or that gains a palette). Never affects the ones already listed below.
settings.sceneAutoDynamicHint: Start the animation automatically, stored at the vendor: Kasbah and the vendor app read the same value. Unchecked, tapping plays the static version and the animation only starts from the ✨ button.
settings.gps: GPS origin of the local frame
settings.pluginsHint: Turn on the vendors this house uses. The choice is written to the house file and takes effect right away; keys and tokens stay in .env.
settings.pluginDetails: Show this plugin's info and settings

hue.title: Philips Hue
hue.instructions: Press the round button on the Hue bridge, then start pairing within 30 seconds.
hue.success: Bridge paired. Add HUE_APP_KEY={key} to apps/server/.env to keep the pairing.
hue.buttonNotPressed: The bridge button was not pressed. Press it, then retry.
hue.repairHint: Only needed if the key was lost: press the round button on the bridge, then start pairing within 30 seconds. The new key must be copied into apps/server/.env.

nest.title: Google Nest
nest.relinkHint: Do this to change which cameras are shared with Kasbah: the choice is made on Google's consent screen.
nest.instructions: The Device Access project is configured. Link your Google account to choose the cameras shared with Kasbah.
nest.opened: Google's consent screen opened in a new tab. At the end, the page shows the token to paste into apps/server/.env; cameras show up here after a refresh.

enphase.title: Enphase gateway
enphase.intro: The gateway requires a token, valid for one year. Pair it from this tablet: the server keeps the token, there is nothing to copy elsewhere.
enphase.expiring: The gateway token expires in {left}. Renew it to keep reading solar production.
enphase.expired: The gateway token has expired: solar production is no longer read. Renew it.
enphase.paired: The gateway is paired. The server keeps the token; nothing to do here while it is valid.
enphase.pairedNeedCloud: The gateway is paired. To reach the charger, validate the Enphase account below: pasting a token is not enough.
enphase.passwordHint: Used to obtain the gateway token and to link the account for the charger, then forgotten: never stored, never logged. They only travel across your local network. Pasting a token does not link the charger.
enphase.tokenHint: Opens the gateway, not the charger: a pasted token does not talk to the Enphase cloud.
enphase.replaceWarn: The current token is still valid for {left}. Creating another one at Enphase would leave this one unused.
enphase.success: Gateway paired. Token valid for {left}, kept by the server.
enphase.successCloud: Enlighten account linked. The gateway token remains valid for {left}.
enphase.serverKept: Token kept by the server in {file}. Nothing to copy, even from a tablet.
enphase.installerNote: An installer token only lasts 12 hours. Enphase's web form gives nothing else to an account that is also an installer: use the Enphase account above to get the one-year token.
enphase.notStored: No token file is configured (ENPHASE_TOKEN_FILE is empty): pairing will be lost when the server restarts.
enphase.cloudLinked: Enlighten account linked: the charger can be read. Session kept in {file}.
enphase.cloudLinkedNoFile: Enlighten account linked for this session only (ENPHASE_CLOUD_FILE is empty).
enphase.cloudNeeded: To reach the charger, pair with the Enphase account: a pasted token does not open the cloud.

renault.title: Renault
renault.intro: Renault offers no delegated sign-in for third parties: your MY Renault e-mail and password are required. The password crosses the server once and is never stored — only a session token is. An account protected by two-factor authentication cannot be linked.
renault.linked: Account linked · {n} vehicle | Account linked · {n} vehicle | Account linked · {n} vehicles
renault.poll: One reading every {min} min, within the {rate} calls per hour Renault tolerates.
renault.notStored: No session file is configured (RENAULT_SESSION_FILE is empty): the link will be lost when the server restarts.
renault.wakeSent: Last charge wake-up: command queued ({detail}). It only takes effect when the car reconnects.
renault.wakeDeferred: Last charge wake-up: Renault is not taking another one right now — a command is already pending.

irobot.title: iRobot
irobot.intro: iRobot offers no delegated sign-in for third parties: your account e-mail and password are required. They are used once, to fetch each robot's LOCAL password — after that everything happens on the home network, the robot pushing its own state. The account password crosses the server once and is never stored. This detour is needed because recent Roombas no longer hand out that local password to whoever asks for it on the network.
irobot.linked: Account linked · {n} robot | Account linked · {n} robot | Account linked · {n} robots
irobot.local: Once linked, the plugin only talks to the robot, directly on the local network: no manufacturer polling, no quota. The robot is found on its own — there is no address to type in.
irobot.notStored: No session file is configured (IROBOT_SESSION_FILE is empty): the link will be lost when the server restarts.

melcloud.intro: Mitsubishi offers no delegated sign-in for third parties: your MELCloud e-mail and password are required. The password crosses the server once and is never stored — only a session key is.
melcloud.linked: Account linked · {n} unit | Account linked · {n} unit | Account linked · {n} units
melcloud.zones: No heating zone published | {n} heating zone published in the home | {n} heating zones published in the home
melcloud.poll: One reading every {min} min, in a single call for the whole account.
melcloud.readOnly: Read-only: setpoints are shown, they cannot be changed from the tablet yet.
melcloud.notStored: No session file is configured (MELCLOUD_SESSION_FILE is empty): the link will be lost when the server restarts.

tesla.title: Tesla
tesla.notConfigured: Create an application on developer.tesla.com (grant type “Authorization Code”, allowed origin: https://YOUR-DOMAIN, redirect: {redirect}), then set TESLA_CLIENT_ID, TESLA_CLIENT_SECRET and TESLA_DOMAIN in apps/server/.env.
tesla.keyStep: 1. Host this public key on your domain, at this exact address (plain text file, served over HTTPS):
tesla.keyHint: The Kasbah server keeps the private key; the public key only proves the domain is yours.
tesla.noDomain: TESLA_DOMAIN is not set: name the domain that will serve the key.
tesla.registered: Domain registered: Tesla has read the key.
tesla.notRegistered: Domain registered, but Tesla did not read our key: check the address above, then try again.
tesla.opened: Tesla's consent screen opened in a new tab. The server keeps the tokens: nothing to copy. Vehicles show up here after a refresh.
tesla.linked: Account linked · {n} vehicle | Account linked · {n} vehicle | Account linked · {n} vehicles
tesla.budget: {used}/{limit} reads today · one read every {min} min while a vehicle is awake, never an automatic wake-up.
tesla.notStored: No token file is configured (TESLA_TOKEN_FILE is empty): the link will be lost when the server restarts.
tesla.rotateConfirm: Confirm: the old key stops working
tesla.rotated: New key generated. Publish it on the domain again, then register the domain again.

water.referenceHint: An order of magnitude, not a verdict: per-person consumption drops in larger households (about 148 L/person for two, 101 L/person for four) and varies a lot by region. On the Year view, the reference is a monthly average: February is compared to an average month, so it looks a bit more frugal than it really is.
